entities.name: Ghâlib ibn Abd al-Rahman
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ghālib ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Nāṣirī, called al-Ṣiqlabī, was a military commander in the ʿUmayyad caliphate of Córdoba, serving the caliphs ʿAbd al-Raḥmān III al-Nāṣir, al-Ḥakam II and Hishām II on both land and sea. For his military prowess, he was granted the honorific Dhu ʾl-Sayfayn.
